trait.name: Flyby
entries: The new creature doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The new creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rot makes one Decaying Longsword attack and uses Battlefield Inspiration

action.name: Decaying Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage, or if the target is a corpse or Undead, the damage increases to 36 ({@dice 8d8}), plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage. If the target is within 5 feet of any of the rot's allies, the target takes an extra 2 ({@damage 1d4}) radiant damage.

Additionally, for the next 24 hours, the target is marked for death. A creature who drops to 0 hit points while marked for death immediately fails one death saving throw. This effect isn't cumulative.

action.name: Battlefield Inspiration
entries: The rot chooses up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Until the end of the rot's next turn, each target can add a {@dice d4} to its attack rolls and saving throws.

bonus.name: Hypnotic Beam
entries: One of the angel's eyes shoots a magic ray at a creature the angel can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move as far as their speed allows toward the angel, avoiding obviously dangerous ground.

reaction.name: Radiant Puff
entries: When the rot is hit with an attack, they release a cloud of spores. Each creature within 10 feet of the rot must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the rot rot's next turn.

A creature born from grafting together two entirely different beings. Though both were once called an Angel, this description definitely doesn't fit them anymore. The Rot Angel basically took the Battleforce Angel as a host, attaching itself onto their head and fusing their Minds to combine their powers, now permanent due to a Wizards Quest for greatness.
